$comment: Shape of one player's save for Gahwit Sitti. Stored on the phone and synced to the platform (PlayerSave.Json). Gems and purchases are NOT here: the platform's Wallet owns them. Times are trusted milliseconds from the time service (server time moved forward by the phone's uptime counter); 'clock' is that service's anchor. 'board.storageSlots' counts the storage slots bought with gems, on top of balance.json board.inventorySlots. 'player.unlocksShown' lists the unlock cards already shown. 'wardrobe.occasions' holds the hearts won for each chapter's occasion, paid once. 'cafe.placed' positions are 0.25 m grid cells from the back-left corner, and rot is in degrees; a wall piece (decor.json 'wall') keeps x as its first 0.5 m cell along the walls, up the side wall from the front and then along the back wall, with z and rot 0. 'account' holds the age gate's answer (birth year only); the sign-in itself lives on the platform, not in the save. 'daily.loginDay' counts daily gifts claimed (the next is dailyLogin[loginDay % 7]); 'daily.tasks' are the tasks of 'daily.tasksDate', the player's local day. 'events.miniBoard:<event id>' keeps a mini board's cells, orders (the level each wants), tokens and paid milestones until the event ends. 'purchases.applied' lists the platform purchase ids whose items (energy, generator copies, decor sets, outfits) are already in the save, so each applies once; gems stay on the platform. 'daily.adsDate' is the local day 'daily.adsWatched' counts. 'recipes.pan' holds up to two items waiting in the cooking pan, and 'orders[].recipe' names a signature dish (Content/recipes.json). 'settings.memoryAssist' is the memory games' easy assist; 'settings.subtitles' shows neutral-Arabic subtitles under the dialect lines; 'settings.reducedMotion' is the player's own switch, and the game also follows the phone's Reduce Motion. 'kitchen.notebook' lists Teta's notebook pages found (an item made at least once, '<chain>_<level>'); 'story.ordersDone' lists story orders served, and 'orders[].story' names a story order. 'saveVersion' counts local saves; the platform keeps its own version for conflicts. Unity code: Assets/_Game/Save.
